query:
DELETE FROM workout_session_sets WHERE workout_session_sets.workout_session_exercise_id IN (SELECT workout_session_exercises.id 
FROM workout_session_exercises JOIN workout_sessions ON workout_sessions.id = workout_session_exercises.workout_session_id 
WHERE workout_sessions.app_user_id = $1::BIGINT) RETURNING workout_session_sets.id
